title: #64 - Redwyne Twins
content:
#64 - Redwyne Twins

Chapter 64 The Redwin Twins

As soon as these words came out, the nobles of the Reach immediately exploded.

"Who do you think you are, Hopper and Horace, who dare to challenge us?"

"You are really overestimating your abilities. Marine Tran is a well-known bastard among the Kingsguard. Do you think that if you can defeat him, you can defeat the Redwyne twins?"

"The people from Hejian are very good at fighting, but they are also very good at talking."

"He just relied on Ser Loras's preference for him and expected that he would not be able to fight, so he was so presumptuous."

When Patrick saw that his new idol was being provoked and the people of Hejian were so insulted by them, he became furious:

"Fart, Arthur is a man who can kill five or six wild boars. How can he be afraid of two little knights? Defeating them is a piece of cake for Arthur. There is no difficulty at all."

But obviously, this remark caused new controversy.

"Look, he's bragging again. Five or six wild boars. Is that something one person can do?"

"That's right, one wild boar is enough for an army of more than a dozen people. To boast that one person can kill five or six wild boars is not only a lack of common sense, but also makes us look like fools."

"That's enough." Loras shouted, "Speaking like this, do you still look like officials' children?"

In fact, he didn't completely believe Arthur's words. At this moment, he also wanted to take a look at this person's true strength, but he still had to do enough to save face.

After the people in the Reach were scolded by their third son, they suddenly became quiet, but the angry expressions on their faces still betrayed their hearts.

The Knight of Flowers then turned to Arthur and asked, "Have you really decided to challenge these two brothers at the same time?"

"Yes, force is the best way to silence people." Arthur responded.

Then he summoned his personal servant Mei Dan and asked him to fetch the sledgehammer and sword Shuo Yuelai he had placed in the hotel.

Medan quickly left and went with Patrick's two attendants to complete the master's order.

After all, it is very difficult for one person to carry two heavy weapons.

After pretending to think for a moment, Loras agreed to the contest.

The battlefield is ready-made, and the fences for group battles have been built and can be used now.

The only drawback is that Arthur himself has no armor. Of course, he could beat the twins without armor.

But after the enthusiastic Knight of Flowers learned that Arthur's armor was still being made, he insisted on asking the attendant to bring his own plate armor and let Arthur wear it to avoid being cut in the battle.

It just so happened that the two of them were about the same height, so the plate armor fit them perfectly.

Arthur happily accepted the offer.

But this attracted more ridicule from the nobles of the Reach, because in their view, Arthur, who could not even wear a beautiful plate armor, was more suspected of being a slanderer.

"Are you bragging? I'll let you know in a moment." This was Arthur's verbal response to the taunt.

Of course, the force response later will be more crude and simple.

After a long time, Mei Dan and others finally brought back Shuo Yue and Sledgehammer.

Arthur, who had already put on Loras's beautiful plate armor, picked up a weapon in one hand and walked into the competition venue.

"You have to be careful not to damage Lord Loras's plate armor. This is not a bargain you can afford."

Before the battle officially started, one of the twins said this.

Another person added: "With a heavy weapon in one hand, I don't know if you can use it."

In response, Arthur just snorted and put down his mask.

Strength will make them shut up obediently.

The three of them stood still, ready to fight.

The fence was crowded with onlookers.

In addition to the nobles of the Reach, many nearby people enjoying the cool air and noble knights also came.

The latter was attracted by the gimmick of the tournament, but it would be a week before he could officially watch the battle. Now was the time to be extremely itchy.

Any battle will ignite their desire for violence and blood.

I don't know if he is an older brother or a younger brother, but someone with a shield in one hand and half a sword in the other took a few steps forward and took the lead in testing.

The other person was holding a two-handed sword and was preparing to retreat.

It seems that these two people are not completely without tactical awareness, Arthur said this about his opponent.

He held Shuo Yue in his left hand and a hammer in his right hand, and struck at the person in front of him.

First, use a hammer to break open his five-pointed shield, and then use Shuoyue and the hammer to give him a few hard blows to temporarily force the person away, then turn around and engage the opponent behind him.

This is Arthur's plan.

After all, he has not yet mastered the ability to use both distraction and concentration to fight two enemies with a sword in his left hand and a hammer in his right hand.

The situation was not much different from Arthur's imagination. Arthur's strange strength and hammer smashed the iron-covered five-pointed shield in one fell swoop, leaving a big hole in the middle.

Then Shuo Yue and his opponent's half-swords collided violently, creating a series of sparks.

"Hey~" This was the response of the onlookers to Arthur's blow that broke the shield.

Obviously, they like this kind of visually impactful picture very much.

Arthur's strength is already great, and Hopper, who also holds a weapon with one hand, is no match for him.

The effect of the first impact between Shuoyue and Hand Banjian already satisfied Arthur.

Because the man in front of him could no longer bear the strength, he had no choice but to guide the sword in his hand to the ground to relieve his strength.

"How could this person be so powerful?" This was the only thought in Hopper's mind.

Just when Arthur was about to pursue the victory and expand the fruits of victory, the attack from behind came.

He waved the New Moon in his left hand to block the sword, then changed his steps and turned half his body so that his hammer could attack the opponent.

"Die!" Horace shouted, and used his two-handed sword to force it, as if he was ready to kill Arthur with this sword.

Two-handed against one-handed, I don't believe you can still hold on.

But obviously Arthur's arm strength exceeded his imagination.

A few breaths passed, Arthur's left hand holding the sword did not move, but his right hand holding the hammer turned around.

Then he smashed it hard.

"Ah!" Horace's thigh suddenly sent a sharp pain, making him scream.

He estimated that the thigh armor should have been deformed by the hammer.

How could this person be so powerful that he could use two heavy weapons that ordinary people could hardly wield flexibly with one hand?

Horace hurriedly pulled away and limped back two steps.

But this caused new trouble for his brother.

Arthur raised his sledgehammer and hit Hobber.

Amid the exclamations of the crowd, the hammer completely broke the wooden shield and hit Hobber.

The Moon also chopped the enemy at the same time. The two violent collisions at the same time made Hobber lose his balance and fell to the ground.

Then the Moon was on his neck.

"I surrender, I surrender!"

Hobber, who fell to the ground, reacted quickly and made the most correct choice.

There was only one enemy left, and Arthur turned and rushed towards him.

After Arthur bent his two-handed sword with a hammer, the man also cleverly expressed his surrender.

"You are really a strong warrior." Horace expressed his admiration in this way.

In just two rounds, Arthur had defeated the twins of the Redwyn family, which made the two people who took off their masks blush and feel inferior.

It also made the onlookers exclaim that it was exciting, but of course some people felt that they had not seen enough.

As for the many noble children of the River Bay, their expressions were different and their faces were extremely exciting.

Even the Knight of Flowers, Loras, became quiet at this moment, as if he was digesting the scene he had just seen.

Arthur was very satisfied with the performance of these people.

He called the servant Medan, asked him to pack up his weapons, and then walked towards Loras and others.
